name: LavaLending borrowable WETH/USDC.e wrapper LP priced from dust residual supply
summary: Lava listed the WETH/USDC.e UniV3 wrapper LP 0x6700b021 as a collateral and variable-borrow reserve and priced it with WrapperOracle: wrapper getAssetsBasedOnPrice(Chainlink-derived sqrtPrice) valued at Chainlink prices, divided by the wrapper's live totalSupply, guarded only by totalSupply >= 1e9 raw. A borrower could borrow the LP out of the reserve and redeem it, leaving aLP collateral claims far larger than the wrapper's residual supply. The per-share price of that dust residual could then be raised cheaply by fee donation, and the inflated price applied to every aLP claim. The attacker minted 430,623.99 LP and supplied it. A helper borrowed it all back and the attacker withdrew the other suppliers' 30.93 LP, then redeemed everything, cutting supply from 33.08 to 2.14 LP. After fee payments into the in-range pool, the oracle price rose from 14.25 to 19.88 USD, and the attacker borrowed every Lava reserve's cash.

loss.notes: Gross depletion of third-party cash in the five Lava reserves the receipt drains to zero. The attacker's own campaign inputs are excluded: the helper's 6,492,300.768118 USDC deposit and the attacker's 430,623.991193131340 LP deposit, both recovered within the receipt. Their abandoned cross-positions (helper: USDC collateral against LP debt; attacker: aLP collateral against the reserve borrows) are not counted as consideration. The LP component is other suppliers' LP withdrawn and redeemed by the attacker. It is valued at the pre-exploit WrapperOracle price (Chainlink-derived fair reserves, block 259645907), not at the manipulated price. Attacker proceeds of about 125,795.6 USDC, 1 USDC.e, 0.00679208 WBTC and 2.25 WETH (the PoC's ~$130k) are not substituted for victim depletion.

ageReset.description: The LP reserve, initialized with LTV 0 and borrowing disabled, becomes collateral (LTV 9000, liquidation threshold 9250, log 19) and variable-borrowable (BorrowingEnabledOnReserve, log 20). Both conditions are exercised, and this is the latest necessary change for the WrapperOracle/LP-reserve combination. It follows the oracle's deployment and its AssetSourceUpdated (block 214545658). The later LTV rise to 9450 at block 219351603 only changes exposure.

Target-1 identity and age. Verified WrapperOracle source: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=42161, address 0xd13a2f836b60847d72d5e6ede6dbd0d604d27c0c, v0.8.20+commit.a1b79de6, 200 runs; SHA-256 of the SourceCode string d47817d2f99fb6ffc2e532d0ac76ffd356bc31f45471ff03a37d741dc0f1252c. latestAnswer() derives sqrtPriceX96 from priceFeed0/1 and calls IWrapper(pool).getAssetsBasedOnPrice. Source-6 (block 215957675 index 5, sender 0x0cf8a611 via helper 0x070dfb94) emits CollateralConfigurationChanged 9000/9250/10250 (log 19), BorrowingEnabledOnReserve (log 20) and ReserveFactorChanged 1000 (log 21). The only later event is CollateralConfigurationChanged 9450/9700/10250 in 0x4f030d93740725a6a1c2e23097fbf1565f15fa154ab277a65a57dd41530fcf9e, block 219351603. LendingPool getConfiguration(LP) (calldata in ageReset) is 0 at 215957638, 0x...010c000000000000 at 215957639 and 215957674, 0x...03e8050c280a24222328 at 215957675 and 219351602, and 0x...03e8050c280a25e424ea at 219351603 and 259645907. So the reserve stayed active and borrowable, never frozen, through the exploit. Collateral enablement and borrow enablement are both necessary: the exploit supplies aLP as collateral, and the helper's variable LP borrow is what shrinks wrapper supply while the aLP claims persist. They postdate the oracle deployment, the source update and the wrapper beacon activation (block 213419690), so source-6 log 20 is the latest causal reset. The 9450 LTV change is exposure only (source-3 arithmetic). Codex partial-review coordinates superseded here: the native-USDC net depletion and the beacon basis are reproduced in source-3 and below. The wrapper (beacon proxy 0x6700b021, implementation 0x1e515301, runtime keccak 0x47e157d8ea643bb5cf75e50c1f29764cf406099cbd7daa14b6aaace499d1cfaf at block 259645907) is not a separate target. Its source is unverified and no defect in its own code is established; it only supplies the fee- and donation-inflatable NAV inputs that WrapperOracle trusts. Its sole beacon Upgraded event (0x0c70c0e899dc53c318fecc289f138b8cdf4d4293088757e6f76fec4ba07d3d61, block 213419690, log 3) precedes source-6, so it could not be the knot even if defect-bearing.
